We propose a unified benchmark for perceptual-level image understanding, covering three perceptual domains: Image Aesthetics Assessment (IAA), Image Quality Assessment (IQA), and Image Structure and Texture Assessment (ISTA). Each domain is organized hierarchically into Domain–Category–Criterion levels, enabling fine-grained perceptual evaluation. The benchmark contains both Visual Rating (VR) and Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks, facilitating comprehensive assessment of models’ abilities to understand and reason about perceptual-level image understanding.
